envFile.label: X API env file
envFile.help: Path to an env file containing X_BEARER_TOKEN plus OAuth 2.0 or OAuth 1.0a user credentials.

baseUrl.label: X API base URL
baseUrl.help: Override the X API base URL if needed.

tokenUrl.label: X OAuth 2 token URL
tokenUrl.help: Override the OAuth 2.0 token endpoint if needed.

allowWrites.label: Allow X writes
allowWrites.help: Enable live posting and replies. Leave off for search/read-only mode.

authMode.label: Write auth mode
authMode.help: auto prefers OAuth 2.0 when client/user tokens are present, otherwise falls back to OAuth 1.0a.

persistRefreshedTokens.label: Persist refreshed OAuth 2 tokens
persistRefreshedTokens.help: Write refreshed access/refresh tokens back to the env file after rotation.
